Abstract states DNA methylation was analysed but reports promoter hypermethylation only 'in cells', leaving it undecidable whether methylation was measured in the 200 patient samples.
Cohort of MDS patients on hypomethylating agents measured TP53 mutation status only, with no epigenetic marker assayed.
Genome-wide DNA methylation measured in 910 prediagnostic blood samples from a multinational cohort and related to the modifiable exposure of tobacco smoking and cessation.

Population-based genome-wide DNA methylation measured in white blood cells with replication and linked to GDF-15 and to prior myocardial infarction, which I read as a risk-stratification link although the framing is mechanistic.
Sperm DNA fragmentation and chromatin condensation assays measure strand breakage and packaging, which the instrument explicitly rules out as an eligible epigenetic mark.
SLC16A3 promoter DNA methylation was measured in human ccRCC cohorts and related to cancer-specific survival (prognosis).
Cross-sectional study of 281 screenees quantified DNA methylation of marker genes in gastric mucosa and related it to smoking and dietary intake.
Systematic review protocol describing planned work, reporting no primary data.
Immunohistochemistry quantified EZH2 and SUZ12 protein expression in megakaryocytes rather than any histone mark or chromatin-state measurement.
Birth cohort measured cord-blood AHRR DNA methylation by pyrosequencing in 531 infants and related it to maternal BMI, smoke exposure and birth outcomes.
Descriptive 15-case cytology series with no comparison group; condensed chromatin here is a morphological description, not a measured mark.
DNA methylation is analysed alongside copy number and expression, but the abstract does not establish whether this is a primary cohort analysis or an in-silico re-analysis of existing datasets.
Case-control comparison of HLA-G promoter methylation by bisulfite pyrosequencing in preeclamptic versus normal human placentas, framed toward diagnosis of preeclampsia.
Biological age in the Dunedin cohort was captured by facial age, blood-biomarker algorithms, Framingham heart age and telomere length, none of which is an eligible epigenetic marker.
Case-control study measured genome-wide DNA methylation in ovarian tissue from women with PCOS versus controls and proposed the loci as disease biomarkers.
Case-control study measured plasma BCAT1 and IKZF1 DNA methylation in 74 cancers and 144 controls as a colorectal cancer screening test.
Triptolide/Minnelide was evaluated only in colon cancer cell lines and mouse xenograft and liver-metastasis models, with no human participants or human-derived samples.
Report of 23 cases, a descriptive case series rather than one of the five eligible designs.
Study measured SNP-driven leukocyte interferon-alpha production and used genetic instruments for coronary risk; no epigenetic marker was measured (the CpG-oligonucleotide is a TLR agonist).

DNA methylation of the miR-34b/c locus was directly quantified in 57 soft tissue sarcomas versus controls and correlated with clinical stage and prognosis, so the measured mark is methylation rather than ncRNA expression.

Individual-level DNA methylation, copy number and expression from 154 gastric tumours and 47 matched normal tissues were analysed and tied to tumour status and drug response, though the clinical link rests largely on expression.
Infinium genome-wide DNA methylation was measured in 109 non-cancerous and 105 tumorous gastric tissues and related to tumour aggressiveness and survival.
Cross-sectional molecular characterisation of 807 colorectal cancers included CpG island methylator phenotype testing and informs a Lynch syndrome screening strategy.
Case-control study measured bisulfite-pyrosequencing methylation at imprinted and other loci in neonates conceived after in vitro maturation versus conventional assisted reproduction.
Case-control study measured global DNA methylation in peripheral blood mononuclear cells of 37 late-onset Alzheimer patients and 44 controls and proposed it as a screening marker.
Minimal residual disease was assessed by flow cytometry to guide ARA-C dosing; no epigenetic marker was measured.
Human liver samples contributed only Gankyrin and phospho-IRAK-1 protein immunohistochemistry, with the chromatin immunoprecipitation and p300/CBP work confined to cell lines and a rat model.
DNA methylation at GSDMB/ORMDL3 CpG sites was measured in children and compared between asthmatics and controls in the BAMSE and Search studies.
Cross-sectional CLSA analysis of 8,516 participants measured six DNA methylation age estimates and related them to socioeconomic disadvantage, a modifiable public-health exposure.
BASE-II/GendAge cohort measured multiple DNA methylation clocks longitudinally and related methylation age acceleration to type 2 diabetes complications.
Prospective multinational heart failure cohort with whole-blood DNA methylation scores and epigenetic clocks related to hospitalisation and mortality (prognosis).
Nested case-control within the Shanghai Women's Health Study measured DNA methylation-based inflammation risk scores and related them to lung cancer risk.
Prospective cohort measured EPB41L3 and HPV16/18 DNA methylation in hrHPV-positive women and evaluated triage accuracy against cytology and HPV16/18 genotyping.
Benchmarking of machine-learning model classes on public cohort datasets is methods development and in-silico re-analysis, not one of the five eligible designs.
Biological age was derived from LC-MS metabolomics; no DNA methylation, histone, chromatin or epigenetic clock measure was assayed.

Plasma 5mC/5hmC methylomes were measured in patients enrolled in a phase 2 olaparib plus durvalumab trial and linked to treatment response and resistance phenotypes, though the paper is partly a methodological inference framework.
Protocol for an observational case-control study describing samples and analyses that will be collected, with no primary results.
Case-control comparison measured CDH1 promoter and enhancer CpG methylation in ileal mucosa and PBMC of Crohn patients versus non-IBD surgical controls.
RADAR is a computational pipeline built on public GTEx/TCGA data, so it is tool development and in-silico re-analysis rather than a primary study.
Conference abstract that states what was analysed but reports no results, so it is an abstract without data.
Blood DNA methylation at 13 APOE CpGs was measured in 5,828 Generation Scotland participants and tested against cognition, cholesterol and Alzheimer/cardiovascular risk prediction.
Cross-sectional study measured dental age and salivary alkaline phosphatase only, with no epigenetic marker.

Conference abstract with data: DNA methylation profiling subclassified 25 paediatric medulloblastomas and was compared against immunohistochemical subgrouping for diagnosis and treatment stratification.
Conference abstract with data: EPIC-array methylation profiling of 94 paediatric CNS tumours was compared with radio-histologic diagnosis and revised the diagnosis in a subset.
Tissue and liquid next-generation sequencing characterised gene mutations and copy number (including chromatin-remodelling genes); no epigenetic mark was measured.
SCT promoter methylation biomarker was developed from cell lines and public ENCODE/TCGA data without an eligible participant-level design.
H2BK120 ubiquitination and H3K27 trimethylation were assayed in melanoma cell lines and mice, while the human specimens contributed only USP7/EZH2 protein expression.

Loss of H3K27 trimethylation was assessed in tumour biopsies from patients enrolled in the BIOMEDE randomised trial alongside sequencing used to guide targeted therapy, though the report is largely descriptive.
